description: Core-1 signed envelopes (spec/core-1/README.md, part 3). signing input = canonical({domain, body}). Verify each envelope under the given domain: accept gives the key ids that signed; reject gives the error code. Signed with the fixed test key in spec/vectors/keys.json, and, for the signature-count bound, keys from fixed seeds. The bounds of part 3 are fixed: a signing input of at most 65536 bytes, 1 to 24 signatures, a signature text of at most 128 characters.

accept.why: a record signed by one key
an identity genesis body under its domain
a body nested exactly 48 levels deep, the Core-1 limit
a signing input of exactly 65536 bytes, the Core-1 limit
24 signatures over one input, the Core-1 limit

reject.why: verified under another domain than it was signed under
a signature whose S is not canonical (S + L)
a member beside body and signatures
a member beside key_id and signature
a key id that is not a key
a domain that names no format version
a body holding a number with a fraction
a body holding an integer beyond 2^53-1
a body holding a lone surrogate in a string value
a body nested 49 levels deep, one past the Core-1 limit
a signing input of 65537 bytes, one past the Core-1 limit, with a genuine signature
25 genuine signatures over one input, one past the Core-1 limit
a signature text of 129 characters, one past the Core-1 limit (checked before decoding, so not invalid_signature)
